reviews.text:
AC quit working Sunday pm.  I left Mid Cities Air a message online that night.   They called early Monday morning,  and came out mid morning to do the repairs.   All completed and AC running nice and cold by 11:00am.
Thank you all very much!   Glad I was referred to you by a close friend.   Will be using your company going forward.

Always enjoy working with Mid-Cities! They are very professiaonl, responsive and efficient at their job. MCAC is informative about maintenance and future upkeep ideas as well. Thank you Jonathan for your awesome work!

Hands down they have my business moving forward.  Being a single mom, I get the run around from many companies. They arrived within an hour of my call and fixed my AC - good price, no scare tactics, friendly, and professional.  I will be adding their number to my contacts!

Their technician is up front and honest. It’s a family owned business, and I call them anytime there an issue with my HVAC system.

Highly recommend this local business.
